sentences.text: Han Lin: Why are you at school so early, Peter? It's only seven o'clock.
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: Han Lin: Why are you at school so early, Peter? It's only seven o'clock.]

sentences.text: Peter: I'm on duty today. You're here early too, Han Lin
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: Peter: I'm on duty today. You're here early too, Han Lin]

sentences.text: Han Lin: I like to do some reading before class. What time do you usually get up?
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: Han Lin: I like to do some reading before class. What time do you usually get up?]
[需要翻译: Peter: At half past six.]

sentences.text: Han Lin: When do you have breakfast?
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: Han Lin: When do you have breakfast?]

sentences.text: Peter: At ten to seven. Before that, I brush my teeth and take a shower.
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: Peter: At ten to seven. Before that, I brush my teeth and take a shower.]

sentences.text: Han Lin: Oh, I usually take a shower at night.
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: Han Lin: Oh, I usually take a shower at night.]

sentences.text: Peter: Really? My family take showers in the morning.
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: Peter: Really? My family take showers in the morning.]
